retained_obligations.description: PBE_ALGS is a private static mut pointer. Concurrent EVP_PBE_alg_add_type/EVP_PBE_find_ex/EVP_PBE_cleanup calls race. The pinned authority has the same unsynchronised stack and its own 'Ideally, this would be done under lock' comment, which the transcription preserves. No safe Rust caller reaches it (all access is inside unsafe extern fns), so this is a C-ABI concurrency obligation, not a new hidden obligation.
retained_obligations.disposition: Recorded; not repaired in this batch (adding a lock changes the authority's documented single-threaded-registration model). BOUNDARY candidate.

retained_obligations.description: ossl_ffc_params_set0_j(d, d->j) frees the slot and then stores the freed pointer. The authority's ffc_params.c:73-80 does exactly this; the Rust comment and test document it and no landed caller passes the slot's own value.
retained_obligations.disposition: Recorded; not repaired to preserve authority behaviour. A hardening batch may add the set0_pqg-style pointer guard with a recorded divergence.

defects.class: transcribed return-value loss (AGENTS.md section 8 compatibility axis)
defects.description: rc2_get_asn1_type_and_iv declared `let i: c_int = 0;` and never assigned it, so the EVP_CIPHER::get_asn1_parameters callback always answered 0 on success. The authority (e_rc2.c:130-156 in both 3.0 and the pinned 3.6.4) assigns the ASN1_TYPE_get_int_octetstring result and returns it, so a successful RC2 parameter decode answers the IV length (8 for these modes). EVP_CIPHER_asn1_to_param callers test the result with <= 0, so the legacy/engine path would report a successful RC2 algorithm-identifier decode as failure.
defects.fix: Assign the ASN1_TYPE_get_int_octetstring result to `i`, keep the already-present `i != l` rejection and the `i > 0` CipherInit guard, and return `i`. No allocation, ownership, ABI, export or layout change.
defects.divergence: None for every valid input: the answer now equals the authority's byte count. Failure arms were and remain -1.
